name: What factors influence the cost of building a rental ADU?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of building a rental ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: ADU construction costs vary significantly based on size, complexity of design, materials chosen, site conditions, and utility hookups. For instance, converting an existing garage is often less expensive than building a new detached unit. Preparing for this, consider your budget range and what features are essential for a desirable rental versus what might be considered an upgrade, as these choices directly impact the overall investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs are influenced by size, design, materials, site conditions, and utility hookups; converting existing structures is usually more affordable than new builds.
